description: This file defines a utility class 'ObjectUtils' that provides static methods for manipulating JSON objects, such as checking for boolean or string entries, creating JSON objects with boolean values, serializing booleans to strings, and adding boolean entries. It is likely used across multiple source files to handle common JSON-related operations.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for JSON object manipulation, including checking entries, creating JSON strings, and adding entries.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject has a specified key with a boolean value, and retrieves the boolean value if present.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a boolean entry and serializes it into a string.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a given key and boolean value.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to a JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject has a specified key with a string value, and retrieves the string value if present.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its JSON string representation ('true' or 'false').
